title: Owner-authorized Solana S1-S4 saved-query provisioning and registry attestation

No BSC, Robinhood, scheduling, raw-payload retention, or delivery is enabled.
owner_authorization: On July 23, 2026 the Owner explicitly authorized the recommended one-time provision-and-run sequence: reconcile S1-S4 from the reviewed static SQL, update the aggregate-query registry, and execute the Solana manual no-send path. Do not activate BSC, Four.meme, or Robinhood; Robinhood remains Uniswap v2/v3/v4 partial_coverage and excluded from market comparison.
Do not modify CA facts, holder cleaning, creator precedence, Dev behavior, wallet clusters, wallet-quality rules, sentiment facts, or recommendation/trading language.

Do not run the manual execution unless all four Dune metadata records and PostgreSQL registry records exactly match the reviewed local SQL definitions and the run meets the UTC D+1 14:00 gate.
